measures.title: Montgomery County: Montgomery City Council members in the Employees' Retirement System (Act 2025-181)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 relating to Montgomery County. It would authorize the members of the Montgomery City Council to participate in the Employees' Retirement System of Alabama.
measures.yesMeans: Members of the Montgomery City Council would be authorized to participate in the Employees' Retirement System of Alabama.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and this authorization for city council members is not added.
